what: Released, fully trained flyvis models (flow/0000/<id>, 250k steps, downloaded by `flyvis download-pretrained`) scored with flyvis 1.2.0's own validation loss on the 1.2.0 default task/validation set (16 sequences, batch 1, 19 frames, dt 0.02, t_pre 0.25 s, network and decoder in eval mode, augmentation off). Same loss definition as curve_L4_2026-09-19.json. Each released dir holds one checkpoint. 'stored' is the validation/loss scalar shipped with the model (the number Stage 0 §5 averaged to 5.3143).
loss_definition: mean over validation set of sqrt(sum over 19 frames x 2 channels x 721 columns of squared flow error)

summary.note: stored/1.2.0 ratio is ~215 and preserves the ranking, so the stored number is the same loss on a different normalization (not identified; not sqrt(19*2*721)=165.5).
